title: Regression Property Inference Attacks & Defense
summary: Code accompanying the research paper "Property Inference as a Regression Problem: Attacks and Defense", which studies property inference attacks against machine-learning models on the Adult, CIFAR-10, and UTKFace datasets. For the Adult dataset, the repository uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (via SingleTableMetadata) to generate the synthetic attack data set that feeds the attack pipeline.
